edge_exceptions.reason: The portable translation splits coordinate movement into WL_MoveObj and the original player-collision/contact-damage semantics into WL_MoveChase.
The portable actor dispatcher calls WL_SightPlayer immediately before WL_T_Path for path think states.
WL_PlayFrame calls WL_ControlMovement and WL_TickPlayerAttack as sibling services for the same player tick.
Bonus collection is performed in the simulation tick before rendering, rather than as a renderer side effect.
The non-blocking session scheduler advances the intermission animation after BeginIntermission returns.
The session state transition redraws the play border when the next gameplay view is entered.
BeginIntermission applies the original ratio bonus directly to the campaign score.
Palette-shift timing is advanced by the generic host/session frame service rather than a blocking PlayLoop call.
The portable actor dispatcher invokes WL_T_BJRun for the BJ state instead of storing a function pointer in the state table.
Run-to-jump state dispatch is folded into WL_TickBJVictory.
The jump action callback is folded into WL_TickBJVictory.
The terminal jump callback is folded into WL_TickBJVictory.

classifications.reason: Segmented DOS memory management is replaced by bounded native allocation.
VGA register and planar framebuffer operations are replaced by the generic indexed framebuffer.
Interrupt and BIOS input backends are host callbacks.
ISA/PIT/DMA hardware setup is replaced by the generic audio stream.
Original development cheats and profiling tools are not production game behavior.
